Apakah Anda percaya akan mukjizat? Apakah Anda percaya pada hal-hal supranatural? Bagaimana dengan campur tangan ilahi? Atau pertanyaan yang lebih baik mungkin, apakah Anda pernah melihat Allah bekerja dalam hidup Anda? Apakah orang lain melihat Allah bekerja dalam hidup Anda?

Saudaraku sedang bekerja di rumah kaca ketika seorang pelanggan masuk dan terkagum-kagum melihat keindahan semua tanaman. Lalu dia berseru betapa terkesimanya dia atas semua kerja keras kami. Saudaraku menjawab, “Beberapa tanaman, sedikit air, tetapi Allah yang memberi pertumbuhan.” Pelanggan itu lalu menanggapi, “Tidak, tidak, jangan beri pujian kepada Tuhan. Kalian datang ke sini dan melakukan semua pekerjaan ini. Kalian menanam, menyiram, dan memberi pupuk semua tanaman ini, dan kalian pantas mendapat pujian, bukan Tuhan!” Alasan pria itu merasa demikian adalah karena dia seorang humanis.

Apa itu Humanisme?

Kamus mendefinisikan humanisme seperti ini; sebuah pandangan atau sistem pemikiran yang menempatkan kepentingan utama pada masalah-masalah manusia daripada yang ilahi atau supranatural. Keyakinan humanis menekankan nilai dan kebaikan potensi manusia, menekankan kebutuhan bersama manusia, dan mencari cara-cara rasional semata untuk memecahkan masalah manusia.

Jika Allah memang ada, maka kita harus mengakui fakta ini dan mempertanggungjawabkannya kepada-Nya. Para humanis berusaha membuktikan bahwa Allah tidak ada, sehingga mereka bisa bebas menjalani hidup sesuka hati. Menurut humanisme, tidak ada Tuhan. Jika demikian, maka kita, ras manusia, lebih unggul dari Tuhan. Segalanya ada untuk kita dan kebahagiaan akhir kita. Inilah definisi humanisme.

Dua Jenis Humanisme

Ada dua jenis keyakinan humanistik, dan kita akan melihat keduanya. Kepercayaan pertama adalah teori bahwa tidak ada Tuhan. Pada kenyataannya, ini tampaknya menjadi satu-satunya cara rasional untuk menjadi seorang humanis. Segalanya diciptakan oleh manusia dan untuk manusia. Tidak ada faktor lain atau keterlibatan supranatural. Segalanya terjadi karena akal dan akal sehat. Ada penjelasan logis untuk segala sesuatu yang terjadi. Tentu saja, beberapa hal tidak masuk akal, tetapi para humanis mengabaikannya dan hanya melihat pada hal-hal yang dapat dijelaskan. Seperti tanaman di rumah kaca, mereka melihat semua yang dilakukan manusia dan mengabaikan bagian supranatural dari tanaman yang muncul dengan kehidupan baru. Para ilmuwan di seluruh dunia bekerja keras untuk memasukkan penalaran manusia ke dalam segala sesuatu yang pernah terjadi, bahkan penciptaan dunia. Para ilmuwan, dengan semua pembelajaran dan kebijaksanaan mereka, berusaha memberi penjelasan logis mengapa bencana alam dan krisis global terjadi. Jika mereka dapat menjelaskan semuanya, maka mereka dapat menyingkirkan Tuhan dan keberadaan-Nya. Ini memungkinkan ras manusia berbuat semau mereka tanpa konsekuensi kekal. Hal ini, pada gilirannya, mengarah pada rasa damai palsu yang besar.

Para humanis, dengan segala penalaran mereka, mengejek keberadaan Tuhan itu sendiri. Jika Anda pergi ke sebagian besar perguruan tinggi di Amerika dan berbicara dengan orang-orang tentang Kekristenan, mereka akan tertawa kepada Anda dan mengejek fakta bahwa orang Kristen benar-benar percaya pada Tuhan.

Jenis kedua dari keyakinan humanistik adalah teori humanisme yang mengakui keberadaan Tuhan. Seorang antropolog berpendapat bahwa humanisme adalah proyek modernitas dan kelanjutan sekuler dari teologi Kristen Barat. Tetapi jika Anda bertanya kepada orang-orang apa arti humanisme menurut mereka, kemungkinan Anda akan mendapatkan jawaban yang berbeda-beda, dan itu menjadi sangat membingungkan. Tetapi mengapa kebingungan itu? Karena orang mencoba menjadi humanis Kristen. Humanisme Kristen sering dikritik karena ketidakjelasannya dan sulit untuk didefinisikan. Alasan mengapa hal itu menjadi sangat membingungkan adalah karena orang ingin percaya pada Tuhan tetapi juga percaya pada diri mereka sendiri dan bahwa dunia berputar di sekitar mereka.

Dalam Roma, kita membaca, “Sebab murka Allah nyata dari sorga atas segala kefasikan dan kelaliman manusia yang menahan kebenaran dalam kelaliman mereka; Karena apa yang dapat diketahui tentang Allah nyata di antara mereka, sebab Allah telah menyatakannya kepada mereka. Sebab apa yang tidak kelihatan tentang Dialah sejak penciptaan dunia, baik kekuasaan-Nya yang kekal maupun ke-Allahan-Nya, dapat dilihat dengan jelas oleh makhluk-makhluk yang diciptakan, sehingga mereka tidak dapat berdalih. Karena mengetahuan mereka tentang Allah tidak membawa mereka memuliakan Dia sebagai Allah, ataupun berterima kasih, tetapi mereka menjadi sia-sia dalam pemikiran mereka, dan hati mereka yang bodoh menjadi gelap. Mereka yang menganggap dirinya berakal, menjadi bodoh, dan mereka mengganti kemuliaan Allah yang tidak binasa dengan rupa yang serupa dengan manusia yang binasa, bahkan dengan burung, empat kaki dan binatang melata. Sebab itu Allah menyerahkan mereka kepada kecemaran oleh nafsu hati mereka sendiri, sehingga mereka menajiskan tubuh mereka di antara mereka sendiri; yang mengganti kebenaran Allah dengan dusta dan menyembah serta melayani makhluk lebih daripada Sang Pencipta, yang diberkati untuk selama-lamanya. Amin. Karena itu Allah menyerahkan mereka kepada hawa nafsu yang memalukan; bahkan perempuan-perempuan mereka mengganti kelaziman alami dengan yang bertentangan dengan alam; demikian juga laki-laki, meninggalkan kelaziman perempuan, menyala dalam nafsu pada satu sama lain, laki-laki dengan laki-laki melakukan perkara-perkara yang memalukan dan menerima dalam diri mereka balasan yang sepadan untuk kesesatan mereka. Dan karena mereka tidak suka memelihara kesadaran akan Allah, maka Allah menyerahkan mereka kepada hati yang bejat untuk melakukan hal-hal yang tidak patut; dipenuhi dengan segala ketidakbenaran, percabulan, kejahatan, ketamakan, jahat hati; penuh iri, pembunuh, pertengkaran, penipuan, kejahatan; para pendengar gosip, pencela, pembenci Allah, penghinaan, sombong, pembual, perancang-perancang kejahatan, durhaka kepada orang tua, tidak berpengertian, pemutus perjanjian, tidak berkasih sayang oleh nalurinya, tak tertaklukkan, tak berbelas kasihan: yang mengetahui penghakiman Allah, bahwa mereka yang melakukan hal-hal demikian layak mati, bukan hanya melakukannya tetapi juga memiliki kesenangan dalam orang-orang yang melakukannya” (Romans 1:18-32).

Jadi bagaimana seseorang bisa menjadi humanis dan percaya pada Tuhan? Di sinilah kita menyentuh sesuatu yang lebih dekat dengan rumah. Jenis humanis ini percaya Tuhan ingin dia bahagia. Dia percaya pada Allah Pencipta tetapi tidak percaya bahwa dia harus melayani-Nya dalam kenyataan. Dia tidak percaya pada Tuhan yang sejati tetapi, dalam pikirannya, menciptakan ilah fiktif yang tidak ada. Ini memungkinkannya hidup untuk dirinya sendiri dan kebahagiaannya sendiri. Jenis orang ini akan berbicara tentang Tuhan, pergi ke gereja, menyanyikan lagu, dan mengucap doa. Namun, dia hanya akan melihat kepada manusia untuk semua kebutuhannya. Jika dia sakit, dia memanggil dokter. Jika dia membutuhkan uang, dia pergi ke bankir. Jika kebutuhan adalah pelarian dari kenyataan, dia mengambil liburan atau retret. Dia hidup untuk kebahagiaannya sendiri dan kemudian berterima kasih kepada Tuhan meskipun dia tidak mencari Tuhan untuk kebutuhannya. Orang-orang ini bergantung pada diri mereka sendiri. Mereka percaya pada kemampuan diri mereka.

Berikut contohnya: Seorang Kristen menanam kebun dan merawatnya setiap hari. Dia menyiram dan memberi pupuk, mencabut gulma dan memangkas. Akhirnya, tanamannya mulai berbuah, buah yang baik. Dia berterima kasih kepada Tuhan atas panen yang melimpah. Tetangganya, seorang humanis ateis, juga menanam kebun. Dia juga pergi setiap hari menyiram, memangkas, mencabut gulma, dan memberi pupuk. Dia juga mendapat panen yang melimpah. Namun, pria ini membanggakan semua yang telah ia capai. Kedua pria melakukan hal yang sama dan mendapat hasil serupa. Yang satu memberi pujian kepada Tuhan, dan yang satu memuji dirinya sendiri. Dia akan mengatakan dia mencapai hal yang sama tanpa Tuhan seperti yang dilakukan tetangganya dengan Tuhan. Orang Kristen tahu bahwa dia salah dan bahwa sebenarnya dia membutuhkan Tuhan untuk menumbuhkan kebunnya.

Saat sesuatu terjadi yang membutuhkan campur tangan supranatural, humanis Kristen berdoa dan meminta orang lain berdoa. Namun, dia tidak percaya bahwa Tuhan akan menjawab doa mereka dan segera bekerja untuk menyelesaikan masalahnya, hanya dengan penalaran manusia. Kemudian, jika masalah itu terselesaikan, dia berterima kasih kepada Tuhan karenanya. Jenis humanisme ini telah membingungkan dunia modern. Ini menyebabkan orang yang tidak percaya mengejek iman Kristen dan menyebutnya agama palsu tanpa kuasa.

Orang Kristen tidak percaya pada penalaran manusia. Orang Kristen percaya bahwa Allah di surga adalah alasan bagi segala sesuatu. "Sebab segala sesuatu diciptakan oleh Dia, baik yang di sorga maupun yang di bumi, yang terlihat dan yang tidak terlihat, baik takhta, maupun pemerintahan, maupun penguasaan, maupun kekuasaan; segala sesuatu diciptakan oleh Dia dan untuk Dia" (Colossians 1:16). Kita bukan apa-apa tanpa Dia, dan tanpa Dia, kita tidak dapat berbuat apa-apa. Kekristenan adalah kebalikan dari humanisme. Ketika orang Kristen melakukan sesuatu yang supranatural, sesuatu yang tidak dapat dilakukan humanis atau ateis, maka kita memiliki sesuatu yang akan membingungkan orang bijak.

Ketika tetangga melihat orang Kristen mengasihi musuhnya, mengampuni seseorang yang menyakitinya, dan melakukan hal-hal yang tidak dapat dilakukannya, dia kemudian mulai bertanya-tanya dari mana kuasa untuk melakukan hal-hal itu berasal. Hal ini kemudian membawanya kepada Bapa. Ketika tidak ada yang supranatural yang kita lakukan, dia bingung.

Bagaimana dengan Kita?

Aku khawatir kita jatuh ke dalam perangkap 'Humanis Kristen' ini. Kita berbicara sesuai kata-kata; kita mengatakan kita percaya kepada Tuhan. Kita pergi ke gereja, menyanyikan lagu, dan mengucap doa. Namun, dari penampilan luar, kita percaya pada diri kita sendiri. Karena kita memusatkan hidup kita pada diri kita sendiri dan kesejahteraan kita, Allah di surga tidak mendengarkan kita. Doa-doa kita tidak dijawab, dan waktu di lutut kita adalah perjuangan paling baik. Kita menjalani rutinitas karena demikianlah kita diajarkan, tetapi iman kita terletak pada penalaran manusia.

Bisa sangat sulit mencari Tuhan sementara hidup dalam masyarakat humanistik. Sebuah masyarakat yang telah menyempurnakan pengejaran kebebasan dan kebahagiaan. Perlahan, gereja mulai tunduk pada cara-cara dunia ini.

Seorang pendeta dari China mengunjungi gereja-gereja di Amerika. Sebelum kembali ke China, dia ditanya apa yang paling mengesankan darinya tentang gereja-gereja di Amerika. Dia menjawab, "Saya kagum dengan apa yang telah mereka capai tanpa Tuhan."

Kita akan bijak jika menyederhanakan definisi modern humanisme. Humanis dengan bangga menyangkal adanya Tuhan ketika ia membanggakan kekuatan dan kemampuannya sendiri. Ia memproklamasikan prestasi besar manusia dan mengejek orang Kristen yang rendah hati.

Orang Kristen menyangkal dirinya sendiri, memikul salibnya, dan mengikuti Gurunya. Orang Kristen tidak memikirkan dirinya sendiri atau kemampuan manusia, dengan yakin mengakui bahwa dia hanyalah debu dan kembali ke debu itu dia akan cepat-cepat pergi. Orang Kristen mencari kebaikan pada orang lain dan mempercayai Tuhan untuk semua kebutuhan dan perhatiannya setiap hari.

Orang Kristen percaya mereka hanyalah hamba bagi Tuan mereka. Mereka dibenci oleh dunia dan dipandang rendah oleh kebanyakan orang, ditolak. "Jika dunia membenci kamu, ketahuilah bahwa ia telah membenci Aku lebih dahulu sebelum ia membenci kamu. (John 15:18)" Bagi mereka, hidup ini bukan pengejaran kebahagiaan. Hal-hal dunia ini bahkan tidak menarik bagi mereka. Sukacita dan damai mereka datang semata-mata dari melayani tuan mereka, dari menyenangkan Bapa mereka di Surga. Bagi dunia, mereka aneh. Orang bodoh. Bagi Tuhan, mereka adalah anak-anak-Nya yang dikasihi.

Allah masih mencari orang-orang hari ini yang akan menaruh kepercayaan pada-Nya. Dia memandang seluruh bumi mencari seseorang, di suatu tempat, yang akan menyingkirkan penalaran manusia dan akal sehat dan taat kepada suara dari surga. Tuhan menginginkan orang dengan iman yang akan melangkah ke dalam hal-hal supranatural, seperti Abraham, Musa, Daud, dan ribuan orang percaya yang mengikutinya. Seseorang yang akan menyangkal dirinya sendiri dan dunia ini dan mengikuti Juruselamat.

Saat hidup ini berakhir, para humanis, apakah mereka mengatakan percaya pada Tuhan atau tidak, akan binasa. Dan orang-orang Kristen akan hidup selamanya dalam kemuliaan.

Humanis? Kristen? Humanis Kristen? Anda termasuk yang mana?

A Christ-centered Courtship is a series of messages on godly courtship preached by Paul Hershberger. He preached these messages several times at different locations over the last ten years. Recently, we had them transcribed and abridged for reading clarity. After printing all six articles in The Heartbeat of the Remnant, we will publish them in a booklet. This is the first article of six.

Introduction

My wife and I had the privilege of having a courtship without regrets or guilt. We were blessed with parents who guided us in the right way and gave us opportunities that they didn’t have.

If you don’t have that testimony or memory, please don’t go on a guilt trip. But my prayer for you is that you get a burning burden and vision in your heart to have it for your children. That can be your reward.

A Christ-centered courtship is a period of time between a single life and a married life. The decisions you make in this period will affect you for the rest of your lives. With God’s blessing on your life, you can end up with no regrets or guilt.

Five goals for this Christ-Centered Courtship series.

Goal #1. To turn the hearts of the fathers to their children.

Goal #2. To turn the hearts of the children to their fathers.

Goal #3. That parents would get a burden to lead each one of their children into the perfect will of God for their lives.

Goal #4. That young people would get a burden to seek after God, find fulfillment and purpose in walking with God, and you would seek maturity in your manners and in your character.

Goal #5. That young men and young women would rise up to be godly fathers and godly mothers with a vision to raise up another godly generation, and the Gospel of Jesus Christ can go on.

God’s Plan for Male and Female

Ecclesiastes 12:1 says, “Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them.” My desire is that each one of you, remember your Creator in the days of your youth. Turn your heart, your focus, and your life to pursue after your Creator, Almighty God, in heaven.

What does he mean, “while the evil days come not” and “the years draw nigh”? It means to seek the Lord when you’re young. Take the energy of your youth and seek after God. Young people, you’re young and full of ideas, visions, plans, and dreams. I doubt there are any of you who just enjoy sitting down in an easy chair, putting your feet up, and just dreaming about how terrible and horrible life is going to be. We don’t do that, do we? But if we don’t walk with God and follow God’s plan, hard things will come upon us. When hard things come in life, we have no place to turn to. We dream that life will turn out well. The decisions and actions in our youth affect us for the rest of our lives. The good news is they can affect us in a good way. The bad news is they can affect us in a bad way. It depends on what decisions and choices we make. But young people, you’re young, and you have the opportunity to choose.

Let’s go to the beginning of Genesis.

“And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him. And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof. And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him. And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof; And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man. And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man. Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:18-24).

“And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth. So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them. And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth” (Genesis 1:26-28).

“And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him” (Genesis 2:18). “I’ll make him an help that is meet for him.” God said He would do that.

“So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them” (Genesis 1:27). God made. God created us male and female. It takes a lot of blind faith to believe that we evolved perfectly as male and female. The creation of male and female is God’s plan. It is one of the living proofs of Creation. God made. God created. It’s God’s plan. God is the Author. And God’s plan brings blessing.

I’d like to look at ten different aspects of this blessing of God’s plan.

1) God brings Eve to Adam.

“And the rib, which the Lord God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man. And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man” (Genesis 2:22-23).

God caused Adam to fall into a deep sleep. Then God created Eve and brought her to Adam. Adam awoke and realized, “This one is for me!” He had seen all the animals go by when he named them. Now God brings him someone that is for him. He also realized, “She was taken out of my side.” She’s close to his heart. “This is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh.” It’s not a dog; it’s not a giraffe, or a monkey, or an ape. This one that God brought to him is like him. God’s plan has a blessing.

Adam and Eve had never had a companion before. Adam and Eve had never let the emotions of their heart go before. Something happened in Adam and Eve’s hearts. Adam was a “one-woman man,” and Eve was a “one-man woman.” They never gave their heart passions to anybody else. God has that plan for us, too. God’s plan brings blessings.

2) Leaving and cleaving in unity for life.

“Therefore Bshall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24).

This verse says, “Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother,” but Adam and Eve did not have a father and mother. What God is saying it doesn’t work for there to be cleaving unless there’s leaving. Also, in Mark 10:7, we read, “For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife.” This is God’s plan, and God’s plan brings blessing.

Leaving means to leave behind, to abandon. “For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother” is to leave parents leave behind. Let’s consider a young man who has a really good home life. He’s blessed and has everything he needs. Yet once God brings his Eve into his life, something rises up inside him, and he says, “I’m leaving!” But this is God’s plan. And God’s plan brings blessing.

It’s not just leaving his father and mother; he also cleaves to his wife. Cleave means “to glue to, to adhere.” We are very familiar with glued wood panels. All kinds of solid furniture are made out of panels glued together. And if they’re glued together right, they will not come apart at the joints. If you tear them apart, you’re going to have to tear the wood apart. God’s glue is the same way, where it glues two people together. The only way to tear them apart is by splintering and ripping and God does not bless that. But leaving and cleaving, staying together and being glued together, that’s God’s plan and it brings blessing.

3) They shall be one flesh.

“Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24). Two single people who become one married couple, become one unit before God, and become one family before God. They become one flesh, where God sees them as together as one.

“And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder” (Mark 10:8-9). God’s plan for male and female is that He brings Eve to Adam. Then the leaving and cleaving to take place. He causes them to become one flesh. Pulling apart is no blessing at all but bringsagony,pain,travail, and hurt. There is no blessing in separation. But God’s plan brings blessing.

4) Not an unequal yoke.

“Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness” (2 Corinthians 6:14-15). “The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord” (1 Corinthians 7:39).

God’s plan is that marriage is an equal yoke. God will not bring an Eve to an Adam in a marriage that is an unequal yoke.Let’s think about leaving and cleaving, getting glued together, and two becoming one. In marriage, those two are now one before God. Imagine being in a bad marriage relationship like this—a family like this trying to function together. There will be no blessing.

But an equal yoke brings blessing! God desires that we be joined together in one flesh, one heart, and one mind. He wants to see us joined in heart, mind, and fleashthe whole being, being one. God’s plan brings blessing.

5) God planned for us to have children.

“And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth” (Genesis 1:28). Think of the joy and miracle every time another child is born into a Christian home. God planned it this way. And if God brought Adam his Eve, and they leave and cleave, they become one flesh, one heart, one mind. If they are equally yoked and God blesses them with children, it becomes a joyful haven where God can dwell. “And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth” (Genesis 9:1). “And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein” (Genesis 9:7). God’s plan brings blessing.

6) Headship order.

“But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God” (1 Corinthians 11:3). It is God, and then Christ, the man, and the woman. God established a headship order, and this headship order is a blessing. It’s God’s plan, and it’s a blessing.

“Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right. Honor thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise; That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth” (Ephesians 6:1-3). . Children, obey your parents in the Lord is a part of the headship order. This not difficult to understand, is it? A home following the plan of God is just a blessed situation. Young people learn to be under authority. Make that your high priority. The sooner you learn to be under authority, the better you will be prepared for the responsibilities in life.

I remember looking at married life and having aspirations about teaching children and raising a godly family. I listened to the “Godly Home” series and thought I was ready to go. But then the day came when it was my turn and my responsibility, and all of a sudden, my heart wanted to wither. Responsibility doesn’t feel the same as dreaming about it does. YOU need to do something! YOU are responsible. YOU need to make it happen. And, by the way, not just make it happen; you need to make it happen in a Christlike way. You need to make it happen in a way that the anointing of the Spirit of God can come down on your family. The better we learn how to be under authority, the better we’ll be prepared for those responsibilities. The more we realize we need God, the better off we are. Let’s make a high priority out of learning to be under authority as children and as young people. “My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee” (Proverbs 3:1-2).

God will add his blessing if we stay in this headship order. The more you learn how to be under authority, the more you will be blessed when you establish your home. God’s plan has blessings.

7) A godly marriage.

Ephesians 5:21,22,24 says, “Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God. Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. . . Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.”

First of all look at verse 21, “submitting yourselves one to another.” There’s a blending together that needs to happen in a godly home. This blending together should happen in the fear of God. If we’re submitting one to another in the fear of God, we’re going to obey God because we want His blessings.

Ephesians 5: 22, 24 “Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. . . Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.” Young ladies, you can count on it: submission to Dad equals submission to a husband. You can practice while you are single. This will help build character in your life. Being a rebellious and froward woman is not going to bring the blessing of God.

It goes on and says, in Ephesians 5:25,28,29. “Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it . . . So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church.” Young men, this says that husbands should love their wives. So who do you think God put in your life to prepare you to love your wife? Your mother! Do you want to learn how to love your wife? Learn how to get along with your mom, love your mom, and care about her. Do you want to practice to love your future wife? Go ahead and love your mom.

Verse 33, “Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.” God’s plan brings blessings.

8) Being heirs together of the grace of life.

1 Peter 3:7 “Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honor unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.” As husbands, we give honor to the wife. She is the weaker vessel and the one that born the children! She’s gone through a lot of traumatic changes in her life. She’s the one that gets worn out and tires sooner.

And he says, “Husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge.”

Young men, learn to understand your mom and your sisters. It will help you after you get married. Don’t conclude that—ah, that’s just women. No, you want the blessing of God. Learn to know and understand them.

“Being heirs together of the grace of life.” God wants us to be heirs together of the grace of life. If we’re not heirs together of the grace of life, can we be heirs separated of the grace of life? I don’t think so. He says we should be heirs together so that our prayers are not hindered. So if we’re heirs separated, could we say our prayers will be hindered? Yes, our prayers will be hindered. Let’s give honor unto the wife as unto the weaker vessel. Every ounce you can gain in this area will only bless you later. It’s worth it. God’s plan brings blessing.

9) A blessed and secure home.

This comes partly out of 1 Peter 3:7, but also from Psalm 144:12 “That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace.” The grace of God is on a secure home where there is unity. Where Dad is understanding Mom, where Dad cares about Mom. Dad is ministering and is there to help and guide. He’s there to give direction with a heart of compassion. God’s plan for male and female—God’s plan brings blessings.

10) As Christ and the church.

“Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing. Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it; That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish. So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church” (Ephesians 5:24-29).

“Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave Himself for it.” God is looking for men who are willing to give their lives. Single young men, who are willing to answer the call and give their life. This is a high calling of God. It’s the plan of God.

Young men, are you willing to lay down your life, your agenda, and those independent things you like to do? Are you willing to be patient, gentle, and understanding? Are you willing to lose sleep and keep going even when you’re tired? Are you willing to stay calm and not react in stressful circumstances? Are you willing to lead and guide a wife and children, eternal souls, through this life?

But my plea is that you would volunteer and say, “I’m willing to apply myself to the Word of God, the will of God, the plan of God, and I’ll give my life. I’m willing to lay it on the altar.” Jesus gave His life for us, and He’s comparing the marriage with the church and Him.

There’s also a need for mothers who are submissive and yielded to authority. Mothers who do not follow the women’s lib of our day but are rather content to be keepers at home.

Young ladies, are you willing to enlist? Will you give your heart to be guided and led? Are you willing to follow and to cheerfully submit to your authority? Are you willing to serve and be spent for your family? Are you willing to serve and be spent for YOUR family? If you get married someday, it will be YOUR family that you’ll be serving and being spent for. Are you willing to bear pain and discomfort? Are you willing to be a helpmeet, giving yourself for his burden and vision?

But as we look at God’s plan and blessings, you want God’s blessing, young people! But that means you need to make choices accordingly. Rise up and make decisions that will lead to maturity. Maturity comes with the process of seeking after God. Make a commitment in your heart to open yourself to God’s blessings and principles. I encourage you to walk with God, to have a relationship with Jesus Christ, and to do so in humility.

Seek after Christlike character, and do it on purpose. It is so easy for us to just live life however it happens. But if we make decisions on purpose, it will take us somewhere! Those decisions matter. Do things according to God’s plan.

God has a plan for male and female and he has a plan for you.

Μια χριστοκεντρική περίοδος ανεπίσημου φλερτ είναι μια σειρά μηνυμάτων για ευσεβές φλερτ που κηρύχθηκαν από τον Paul Hershberger. Τα μηνύματα αυτά κηρύχθηκαν πολλές φορές σε διάφορα μέρη τα τελευταία δέκα χρόνια. Πρόσφατα, τα μεταγράψαμε και τα περικόψαμε για σαφήνεια ανάγνωσης. Αφού δημοσιεύσουμε και τα έξι άρθρα στο The Heartbeat of the Remnant, θα τα εκδώσουμε σε φυλλάδιο. Αυτό είναι το πρώτο από έξι άρθρα.

Εισαγωγή

Η σύζυγός μου κι εγώ είχαμε το προνόμιο μιας περιόδου γνωριμίας χωρίς μετανιώματα ή ενοχές. Είχαμε την ευλογία να έχουμε γονείς που μας καθοδήγησαν στον σωστό δρόμο και μας έδωσαν ευκαιρίες που οι ίδιοι δεν είχαν.

Αν δεν έχετε αυτή την μαρτυρία ή ανάμνηση, παρακαλώ μην μπείτε σε έναν κύκλο ενοχής. Αλλά η προσευχή μου για σας είναι να αποκτήσετε ένα καυτό φορτίο και όραμα στην καρδιά σας να το έχετε για τα παιδιά σας. Αυτό μπορεί να είναι η ανταμοιβή σας.

Μια χριστοκεντρική περίοδος γνωριμίας είναι μια χρονική περίοδος ανάμεσα στην εργένικη ζωή και τη συζυγική ζωή. Οι αποφάσεις που παίρνετε σε αυτή την περίοδο θα σας επηρεάσουν για το υπόλοιπο της ζωής σας. Με την ευλογία του Θεού στη ζωή σας, μπορείτε να καταλήξετε χωρίς μετανιώματα ή ενοχές.

Πέντε στόχοι για αυτή τη σειρά «Χριστοκεντρική Γνωριμία».

Στόχος #1. Να γυρίσουν οι καρδιές των πατέρων προς τα παιδιά τους.

Στόχος #2. Να γυρίσουν οι καρδιές των παιδιών προς τους πατέρες τους.

Στόχος #3. Να αποκτήσουν οι γονείς ένα φορτίο να οδηγούν κάθε ένα από τα παιδιά τους στο τέλειο θέλημα του Θεού για τη ζωή τους.

Στόχος #4. Να αποκτήσουν οι νέοι ένα φορτίο να αναζητούν τον Θεό, να βρίσκουν εκπλήρωση και σκοπό στο να περπατούν με τον Θεό, και να αναζητήσουν ωριμότητα στους τρόπους και τον χαρακτήρα τους.

Στόχος #5. Να σηκωθούν νέοι άνδρες και νέες γυναίκες να γίνουν ευσεβείς πατέρες και ευσεβείς μητέρες με όραμα να αναθρέψουν μια ακόμη ευσεβή γενιά, και το Ευαγγέλιο του Ιησού Χριστού να συνεχίσει.

Το σχέδιο του Θεού για Άνδρα και Γυναίκα

Ο Εκκλησιαστής 12:1 λέει, “Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them.” Η επιθυμία μου είναι να θυμάται ο καθένας σας τον Δημιουργό του στις ημέρες της νιότης σας. Στρέψτε την καρδιά σας, την προσοχή σας και τη ζωή σας στο να επιδιώξετε τον Δημιουργό σας, τον Παντοδύναμο Θεό, στους ουρανούς.

Τι σημαίνει «while the evil days come not» και «the years draw nigh»; Σημαίνει να αναζητήσετε τον Κύριο όταν είστε νέοι. Πάρτε την ενέργεια της νιότης σας και αναζητήστε τον Θεό. Νέοι, είστε νέοι και γεμάτοι ιδέες, οράματα, σχέδια και όνειρα. Αμφιβάλλω αν υπάρχει κάποιος από εσάς που απλά απολαμβάνει να κάθεται σε μια αναπαυτική πολυθρόνα, να βγάζει τα πόδια του και να ονειρεύεται πόσο τρομερή και φρικτή θα είναι η ζωή. Δεν το κάνουμε αυτό, έτσι δεν είναι; Αλλά αν δεν περπατούμε με τον Θεό και δεν ακολουθούμε το σχέδιο του Θεού, σκληρά πράγματα θα συμβούν σε εμάς. Όταν έρθουν δύσκολες ημέρες στη ζωή, δεν θα έχουμε πού να γυρίσουμε. Ονειρευόμαστε ότι η ζωή θα πάει καλά. Οι αποφάσεις και οι πράξεις στη νιότη μας μας επηρεάζουν για το υπόλοιπο της ζωής μας. Τα καλά νέα είναι ότι μπορούν να μας επηρεάσουν θετικά. Τα κακά νέα είναι ότι μπορούν να μας επηρεάσουν αρνητικά. Εξαρτάται από τις αποφάσεις και τις επιλογές που παίρνουμε. Αλλά νέοι, είστε νέοι και έχετε την ευκαιρία να επιλέξετε.

Ας πάμε στην αρχή της Γένεσης.

“And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him. And out of the ground the LORD God formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof. And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him. And the LORD God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof; And the rib, which the LORD God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man. And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man. Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:18-24).

“And God said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth. So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them. And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth” (Genesis 1:26-28).

“And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him” (Genesis 2:18). “I’ll make him an help that is meet for him.” Ο Θεός είπε ότι θα το κάνει.

“So God created man in his own image, in the image of God created he him; male and female created he them” (Genesis 1:27). Ο Θεός έπλασε. Ο Θεός μας δημιούργησε άνδρα και γυναίκα. Χρειάζεται πολύ τυφλή πίστη για να πιστέψει κανείς ότι εξελιχθήκαμε τέλεια ως άνδρες και γυναίκες. Η δημιουργία του άνδρα και της γυναίκας είναι το σχέδιο του Θεού. Είναι μία από τις ζωντανές αποδείξεις της Δημιουργίας. Ο Θεός έκανε. Ο Θεός δημιούργησε. Είναι το σχέδιο του Θεού. Ο Θεός είναι ο Συγγραφέας. Και το σχέδιο του Θεού φέρνει ευλογία.

Θα ήθελα να εξετάσω δέκα διαφορετικές όψεις αυτής της ευλογίας του σχεδίου του Θεού.

1) Ο Θεός φέρνει την Εύα στον Αδάμ.

“And the rib, which the Lord God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man. And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man” (Genesis 2:22-23).

Ο Θεός έκανε τον Αδάμ να πέσει σε βαθύ ύπνο. Έπειτα ο Θεός δημιούργησε την Εύα και την έφερε στον Αδάμ. Ο Αδάμ ξύπνησε και συνειδητοποίησε, «Αυτή είναι για μένα!» Είχε δει όλα τα ζώα να περνούν όταν τα ονόμαζε. Τώρα ο Θεός του φέρνει κάποιον που είναι γι’ αυτόν. Συνειδητοποίησε επίσης, «Ελήφθη από το πλευρό μου.» Είναι κοντά στην καρδιά του. «Αυτό είναι κόκκαλο από τα κόκκαλά μου και σάρκα από τη σάρκα μου.» Δεν είναι σκύλος· δεν είναι καμηλοπάρδαλη, ούτε μαϊμού, ούτε πίθηκος. Αυτή που ο Θεός του έφερε είναι σαν αυτόν. Το σχέδιο του Θεού έχει μια ευλογία.

Ο Αδάμ και η Εύα δεν είχαν ποτέ πριν σύντροφο. Ο Αδάμ και η Εύα δεν είχαν ποτέ αφήσει τα συναισθήματα της καρδιάς τους να πάνε μπροστά. Κάτι συνέβη στις καρδιές του Αδάμ και της Εύας. Ο Αδάμ ήταν άνθρωπος μιας γυναίκας, και η Εύα ήταν γυναίκα ενός άνδρα. Δεν έδωσαν τις παρορμήσεις της καρδιάς τους σε κανέναν άλλον. Ο Θεός έχει αυτό το σχέδιο και για εμάς. Το σχέδιο του Θεού φέρνει ευλογίες.

2) Αποχώρηση και προσκόλληση σε ενότητα για όλη τη ζωή.

“Therefore Bshall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24).

Αυτό το εδάφιο λέει, «Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother,» αλλά ο Αδάμ και η Εύα δεν είχαν πατέρα και μητέρα. Αυτό που λέει ο Θεός είναι ότι δεν λειτουργεί η προσκόλληση χωρίς την αποχώρηση. Επίσης, στον Μάρκο 10:7 διαβάζουμε, «For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and cleave to his wife.» Αυτό είναι το σχέδιο του Θεού, και το σχέδιο του Θεού φέρνει ευλογία.

Αποχώρηση σημαίνει να αφήνεις πίσω, να εγκαταλείπεις. «For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother» σημαίνει να αφήσει πίσω τους γονείς. Ας σκεφτούμε έναν νεαρό άνδρα που έχει πραγματικά καλή οικογενειακή ζωή. Έχει ευλογία και όλα όσα χρειάζεται. Όμως μόλις ο Θεός φέρει την Εύα του στη ζωή του, κάτι ανεβαίνει μέσα του, και λέει, «Φεύγω!» Αλλά αυτό είναι το σχέδιο του Θεού. Και το σχέδιο του Θεού φέρνει ευλογία.

Δεν είναι μόνο να φύγει από τον πατέρα και τη μητέρα· επίσης προσκολλάται στη γυναίκα του. Το «προσκολλάται» σημαίνει «κολλάει, προσκολλάται». Είμαστε πολύ εξοικειωμένοι με κολλητές ξύλινες πλάκες. Όλα τα είδη συμπαγών επίπλων κατασκευάζονται από πλάκες κολλημένες μεταξύ τους. Και αν κολληθούν σωστά, δεν θα χωρίσουν στις ενώσεις. Αν τα τραβήξεις, θα πρέπει να σκίσεις το ξύλο. Η κόλλα του Θεού είναι το ίδιο, όπου κολλάει δύο ανθρώπους μαζί. Ο μόνος τρόπος να τους χωρίσεις είναι με σχίσμα και ξερίζωμα και ο Θεός δεν ευλογεί αυτό. Αλλά η αποχώρηση και η προσκόλληση, το να μένουν μαζί και να είναι κολλημένοι, αυτό είναι το σχέδιο του Θεού και φέρνει ευλογία.

3) Θα είναι μία σάρκα.

“Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh” (Genesis 2:24). Δύο ανύπαντροι που γίνονται ένα παντρεμένο ζευγάρι, γίνονται μια ενότητα μπροστά στον Θεό και γίνονται μια οικογένεια μπροστά στον Θεό. Γίνονται μία σάρκα, όπου ο Θεός τους βλέπει ως ενωμένους σε ένα.

“And they twain shall be one flesh: so then they are no more twain, but one flesh. What therefore God hath joined together, let not man put asunder” (Mark 10:8-9). Το σχέδιο του Θεού για άνδρα και γυναίκα είναι ότι αυτός φέρνει την Εύα στον Αδάμ. Έπειτα να γίνει η αποχώρηση και η προσκόλληση. Κάνει να γίνουν μία σάρκα. Το να τους ξεχωρίζεις δεν είναι καθόλου ευλογία αλλά φέρνει αγωνία, πόνο, μαστίγωμα και πλήγμα. Δεν υπάρχει ευλογία στον διαχωρισμό. Αλλά το σχέδιο του Θεού φέρνει ευλογία.

4) Όχι άνισο ζυγό.

“Be ye not unequally yoked together with unbelievers: for what fellowship hath righteousness with unrighteousness” (2 Corinthians 6:14-15). “The wife is bound by the law as long as her husband liveth; but if her husband be dead, she is at liberty to be married to whom she will; only in the Lord” (1 Corinthians 7:39).

Το σχέδιο του Θεού είναι ότι ο γάμος είναι ένας ίσος ζυγός. Ο Θεός δεν θα φέρει μια Εύα σε έναν Αδάμ σε ένα γάμο που είναι άνισος ζυγός. Ας σκεφτούμε την αποχώρηση και την προσκόλληση, το να κολλάνε μαζί, και το δύο να γίνονται ένα. Στον γάμο, αυτοί οι δύο είναι τώρα ένα μπροστά στον Θεό. Φανταστείτε να είστε σε μια κακή γαμική σχέση—μια οικογένεια σαν αυτή που προσπαθεί να λειτουργήσει μαζί. Δεν θα υπάρξει ευλογία.

Αλλά ένας ίσος ζυγός φέρνει ευλογία! Ο Θεός επιθυμεί να είμαστε ενωμένοι σε μία σάρκα, μία καρδιά και ένα νου. Θέλει να μας δει ενωμένους στην καρδιά, στο νου και στη σάρκα—το όλον είναι ένα. Το σχέδιο του Θεού φέρνει ευλογία.

5) Ο Θεός προγραμμάτισε να έχουμε παιδιά.

“And God blessed them, and God said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth” (Genesis 1:28). Σκεφτείτε τη χαρά και το θαύμα κάθε φορά που άλλο ένα παιδί γεννιέται σε ένα χριστιανικό σπίτι. Ο Θεός το προγραμμάτισε έτσι. Και αν ο Θεός έφερε στον Αδάμ την Εύα του, και αυτοί φύγουν και προσκολληθούν, γίνονται μία σάρκα, μία καρδιά, ένα νου. Αν είναι ίσα ζευγάρια και ο Θεός τους ευλογεί με παιδιά, γίνεται μια χαρούμενη φωλιά όπου ο Θεός μπορεί να κατοικήσει. “And God blessed Noah and his sons, and said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth” (Genesis 9:1). “And you, be ye fruitful, and multiply; bring forth abundantly in the earth, and multiply therein” (Genesis 9:7). Το σχέδιο του Θεού φέρνει ευλογία.

6) Τάξη κεφαλαιότητας.

“But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God” (1 Corinthians 11:3). Είναι ο Θεός, και μετά ο Χριστός, ο άνδρας και η γυναίκα. Ο Θεός θέσπισε μια τάξη κεφαλαιότητας, και αυτή η τάξη κεφαλαιότητας είναι ευλογία. Είναι το σχέδιο του Θεού, και είναι ευλογία.

“Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right. Honor thy father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise; That it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth” (Ephesians 6:1-3). . Παιδιά, υπακούετε στους γονείς σας εν Κυρίω είναι μέρος της τάξης κεφαλαιότητας. Αυτό δεν είναι δύσκολο να καταλάβει κανείς, έτσι δεν είναι; Ένα σπίτι που ακολουθεί το σχέδιο του Θεού είναι απλώς μια ευλογημένη κατάσταση. Οι νέοι μαθαίνουν να είναι υπό εξουσία. Κάντε αυτό την ύψιστη προτεραιότητά σας. Όσο πιο σύντομα μάθετε να είστε υπό εξουσία, τόσο καλύτερα θα είστε προετοιμασμένοι για τις ευθύνες της ζωής.

Θυμάμαι που κοίταζα τη συζυγική ζωή και είχα φιλοδοξίες για διδασκαλία παιδιών και ανατροφή μιας ευσεβούς οικογένειας. Άκουγα τη σειρά «Θεοσεβές Σπίτι» και νόμιζα ότι ήμουν έτοιμος να προχωρήσω. Αλλά τότε ήρθε η μέρα που ήταν η σειρά και η ευθύνη μου, και ξαφνικά η καρδιά μου ήθελε να μαραθεί. Η ευθύνη δεν νιώθει το ίδιο όπως όταν τη φαντάζεσαι. ΕΣΥ πρέπει να κάνεις κάτι! ΕΣΥ είσαι υπεύθυνος. ΕΣΥ πρέπει να το πραγματοποιήσεις. Και, παρεμπιπτόντως, όχι μόνο να το πραγματοποιήσεις· πρέπει να το πραγματοποιήσεις με χριστοειδή τρόπο. Πρέπει να το πραγματοποιήσεις με τρόπο ώστε να μπορεί να κατέβει η χρίση του Πνεύματος του Θεού στην οικογένειά σου. Όσο καλύτερα μαθαίνουμε να είμαστε υπό εξουσία, τόσο καλύτερα θα είμαστε προετοιμασμένοι για αυτές τις ευθύνες. Όσο περισσότερο συνειδητοποιούμε ότι χρειαζόμαστε τον Θεό, τόσο καλύτερα είμαστε. Κάντε ύψιστη προτεραιότητα το να μάθετε να είστε υπό εξουσία ως παιδιά και ως νέοι. “My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee” (Proverbs 3:1-2).

Ο Θεός θα προσθέσει την ευλογία του αν μείνουμε σε αυτή την τάξη κεφαλαιότητας. Όσο περισσότερο μαθαίνεις πώς να είσαι υπό εξουσία, τόσο περισσότερο θα ευλογηθείς όταν ιδρύσεις το σπίτι σου. Το σχέδιο του Θεού έχει ευλογίες.

7) Ένας ευσεβής γάμος.

Εφεσίους 5:21,22,24 λέει, “Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God. Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. . . Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.”

Πρώτα κοιτάξτε το εδάφιο 21, «submitting yourselves one to another.» Υπάρχει ένας εναρμονισμός που πρέπει να συμβεί σε ένα ευσεβές σπίτι. Αυτός ο εναρμονισμός πρέπει να συμβεί «εις φόβον του Θεού». Αν υποβαλλόμαστε ο ένας στον άλλο «εις φόβον του Θεού», θα υπακούσουμε στον Θεό επειδή θέλουμε τις ευλογίες Του.

Εφεσίους 5: 22, 24 «Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. . . Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing.» Νεαρές κυρίες, μπορείτε να το υπολογίζετε: η υποταγή στον πατέρα ισοδυναμεί με υποταγή σε σύζυγο. Μπορείτε να εξασκηθείτε ενώ είστε ανύπαντρες. Αυτό θα βοηθήσει να χτιστεί χαρακτήρας στη ζωή σας. Το να είσαι επαναστατική και ασυνεπής γυναίκα δεν θα φέρει την ευλογία του Θεού.

Συνεχίζει και λέει, στα Εφεσίους 5:25,28,29. “Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it . . . So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church.” Νέοι άνδρες, αυτό λέει ότι οι σύζυγοι πρέπει να αγαπούν τις γυναίκες τους. Λοιπόν ποια νομίζετε ότι έβαλε ο Θεός στη ζωή σας για να σας προετοιμάσει να αγαπήσετε τη γυναίκα σας; Τη μητέρα σας! Θέλετε να μάθετε πώς να αγαπάτε τη γυναίκα σας; Μάθετε πώς να τα πηγαίνετε καλά με τη μητέρα σας, αγαπήστε τη μητέρα σας και νοιαστείτε γι’ αυτήν. Θέλετε να εξασκηθείτε να αγαπάτε τη μελλοντική σας σύζυγο; Πηγαίνετε και αγαπήστε τη μητέρα σας.

Εδάφιο 33, “Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.” Το σχέδιο του Θεού φέρνει ευλογίες.

8) Συμπληρωματικοί κληρονόμοι της χάρης της ζωής.

1 Πέτρου 3:7 “Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honor unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.” Ως σύζυγοι, δίνουμε τιμή στη σύζυγο. Είναι το «ασθενέστερο σκεύος» και αυτή που γέννησε τα παιδιά! Έχει περάσει από πολλές τραυματικές αλλαγές στη ζωή της. Είναι αυτή που εξαντλείται και κουράζεται πιο γρήγορα.

Και λέει, «Husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge.»

Νέοι άνδρες, μάθετε να καταλαβαίνετε τη μητέρα σας και τις αδελφές σας. Θα σας βοηθήσει αφού παντρευτείτε. Μην συμπεράνετε ότι—αχ, αυτό είναι απλώς γυναίκες. Όχι, θέλετε την ευλογία του Θεού. Μάθετε να τις γνωρίζετε και να τις καταλαβαίνετε.

«Being heirs together of the grace of life.» Ο Θεός θέλει να είμαστε κληρονόμοι μαζί της χάρης της ζωής. Αν δεν είμαστε κληρονόμοι μαζί της χάρης της ζωής, μπορούμε να είμαστε κληρονόμοι χωρισμένοι της χάρης της ζωής; Δεν νομίζω. Λέει ότι πρέπει να είμαστε κληρονόμοι μαζί ώστε οι προσευχές μας να μην εμποδίζονται. Άρα αν είμαστε κληρονόμοι χωρισμένοι, θα μπορούσαμε να πούμε ότι οι προσευχές μας θα εμποδίζονται; Ναι, οι προσευχές μας θα εμποδίζονται. Ας δώσουμε λοιπόν τιμή στη σύζυγο ως στο ασθενέστερο σκεύος. Κάθε ουγγιά που μπορείτε να κερδίσετε σε αυτόν τον τομέα θα σας ευλογήσει αργότερα. Αξίζει. Το σχέδιο του Θεού φέρνει ευλογία.

9) Ένα ευλογημένο και ασφαλές σπίτι.

Αυτό προέρχεται εν μέρει από το 1 Πέτρου 3:7, αλλά και από τον Ψαλμό 144:12 “That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace.” Η χάρη του Θεού είναι πάνω σε ένα ασφαλές σπίτι όπου υπάρχει ενότητα. Όπου ο Πατέρας καταλαβαίνει τη Μητέρα, όπου ο Πατέρας νοιάζεται για τη Μητέρα. Ο Πατέρας λειτουργεί ως ποιμένας και είναι εκεί για να βοηθά και να καθοδηγεί. Είναι εκεί να δίνει κατεύθυνση με καρδιά συμπόνιας. Το σχέδιο του Θεού για άνδρα και γυναίκα—το σχέδιο του Θεού φέρνει ευλογίες.

10) Ως ο Χριστός και η εκκλησία.

“Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing. Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it; That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish. So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his wife loveth himself. For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as the Lord the church” (Ephesians 5:24-29).

“Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave Himself for it.” Ο Θεός αναζητά άνδρες που είναι πρόθυμοι να δώσουν τη ζωή τους. Άγαμοι νέοι άνδρες, να είστε πρόθυμοι να απαντήσετε στο κάλεσμα και να δώσετε τη ζωή σας. Αυτό είναι ένα υψηλό κάλεσμα του Θεού. Είναι το σχέδιο του Θεού.

Νέοι άνδρες, είστε πρόθυμοι να θέσετε κάτω τη ζωή σας, το δικό σας πρόγραμμα και εκείνα τα ανεξάρτητα πράγματα που σας αρέσει να κάνετε; Είστε πρόθυμοι να είστε υπομονετικοί, ήρεμοι και κατανοητικοί; Είστε πρόθυμοι να χάσετε ύπνο και να συνεχίσετε ακόμη κι όταν είστε κουρασμένοι; Είστε πρόθυμοι να παραμείνετε ψύχραιμοι και να μην αντιδράτε σε αγχωτικές περιστάσεις; Είστε πρόθυμοι να οδηγείτε και να καθοδηγείτε μια σύζυγο και παιδιά, αιώνιες ψυχές, μέσα από αυτή τη ζωή;

Αλλά η παράκλησή μου είναι να εθελονθείτε και να πείτε, «Είμαι πρόθυμος να εφαρμόσω τον Λόγο του Θεού, το θέλημα του Θεού, το σχέδιο του Θεού, και θα δώσω τη ζωή μου. Είμαι πρόθυμος να την βάλω στην θυσία.» Ο Ιησούς έδωσε τη ζωή Του για εμάς, και συγκρίνει τον γάμο με την εκκλησία και με Εκείνον.

Υπάρχει επίσης ανάγκη για μητέρες που είναι υποταγμένες και παραδομένες στην εξουσία. Μητέρες που δεν ακολουθούν το γυναικείο κίνημα της εποχής μας αλλά είναι μάλλον ευχαριστημένες να είναι φροντιστές του σπιτιού.

Νεαρές κυρίες, είστε πρόθυμες να στρατευθείτε; Θα δώσετε την καρδιά σας για να καθοδηγηθείτε και να οδηγηθείτε; Είστε πρόθυμες να ακολουθήσετε και να υποβάλλεστε με χαρά στην εξουσία σας; Είστε πρόθυμες να υπηρετήσετε και να εξαντληθείτε για την οικογένειά σας; Είστε πρόθυμες να υπηρετήσετε και να εξαντληθείτε για ΤΗΝ οικογένειά ΣΑΣ; Αν παντρευτείτε κάποια μέρα, θα είναι Η δική ΣΑΣ οικογένεια για την οποία θα υπηρετείτε και θα εξαντλείστε. Είστε πρόθυμες να αντέξετε πόνο και δυσφορία; Είστε πρόθυμες να γίνετε βοηθός, δίνοντάς τον εαυτό σας για το φορτίο και το όραμά του;

Αλλά καθώς κοιτάζουμε το σχέδιο και τις ευλογίες του Θεού, θέλετε την ευλογία του Θεού, νέοι! Αλλά αυτό σημαίνει ότι πρέπει να πάρετε αποφάσεις ανάλογες. Σηκωθείτε και πάρτε αποφάσεις που θα οδηγήσουν στην ωριμότητα. Η ωριμότητα έρχεται με τη διαδικασία του να αναζητάς τον Θεό. Κάντε μια δέσμευση στην καρδιά σας να ανοίξετε τον εαυτό σας στις ευλογίες και τις αρχές του Θεού. Σας ενθαρρύνω να περπατήσετε με τον Θεό, να έχετε μια σχέση με τον Ιησού Χριστό, και να το κάνετε με ταπείνωση.

Αναζητήστε τον Χριστοειδή χαρακτήρα, και κάντε το με πρόθεση. Είναι τόσο εύκολο για εμάς απλώς να ζούμε τη ζωή όπως κι αν συμβεί. Αλλά αν παίρνουμε αποφάσεις με πρόθεση, θα μας οδηγήσουν κάπου! Αυτές οι αποφάσεις έχουν σημασία. Κάντε τα σύμφωνα με το σχέδιο του Θεού.

Ο Θεός έχει ένα σχέδιο για άνδρα και γυναίκα και έχει ένα σχέδιο για σας.

Our Father’s world is a world unspoiled by human invention and intervention. While sin and technology have warped and stolen many lovely things from the human race, there abide still a few that remain unmarred by civilization. Little children in the fresh innocence of their unsoiled morning top the ranks as a bit of heaven on earth and call all observers heavenward. Another is the fowl of the air as prescribed in Genesis. Paul pleaded with the Corinthian church, “Doth not nature itself teach you?” We are exhorted to consider the lilies, the ravens, and the grass of the field. Each of these bears a significant dimension of the eternal God in their existence and gives us definition to their Creator. Perhaps all of nature can give us snapshots into heavenly places if we had the time and eyes to observe it.

Birds hold a unique place in God’s creation, for their sphere is in the heavens. Man may mount on the wings of a plane and evade the lower earth for a few hours, but the heavens will never be a place of his common dominion. The birds are a picture of a heavenly race, for they are at home there. They are a natural representation of the saints and angels of God and so we do well to give them due attention. While there may be dozens of lessons to be drawn from these vessels of grace and beauty, one of the most prominent and outstanding virtues will be observed in the song that they raise. Many animals dwelling on the earth are virtually mute. Of the ones that do speak, it is often to threaten or express complaint. “Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? Or loweth the ox over his fodder?” (Job 6:5). When they are happy and content, they have no message to convey. The dog barks at an intruder to drive him away, while the cat mews for attention. They speak when they are threatened or dissatisfied, in fear or in pain. Similarly, the earthly human shares its nature with the mammals of the field.

Birds are diverse. They exercise their joyous vocals so much that they are the epitome of happiness. The expression “happy as a lark” is so common a term that it is used by people who have never even ventured to the meadow to see or hear a lark. While some may inform us that these songs are mere mating calls and have little to do with their feelings, we cannot escape the inner conviction that, whether mating or not, these birds delight in bearing a jubilant expression of joy and we do well to let them teach us. “Is any merry? Let him sing psalms” (James 5:13). The birds do this incessantly and it seems impossible to draw any other conclusion but that they are happy while doing so. Wander near the nest of a swallow and you will find that they have ways of expressing depreciation as well. The killdeer also has no qualms with expressing rash disfavor to those who intrude their domain, but these are not to be mistaken as songs. The singing birds are a beautiful painted picture of the saints and angels of God.

How little knowledge of heaven is committed to our understanding. The scenes of heavens described and laid out before us in Revelations can hardly bring our finite minds into its infinite realm. One dimension that we can connect with is that it is a place filled with singing. Little wonder, for it is the culminating end of the contented and joy-filled saints of God, and there they will sing a new song. Nearly every scene at the throne in Revelations is marked by some dimension of praise. “And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God” (Ps 40:3). On 22 occasions, the Scriptures reiterate the phrase, I will sing.

It is the nature of the birds to sing. It is their waking thought as morning guilds the sky, and it flows from within them like a fountain. Not all of their songs are alike. Some are elaborate in their duration, meter, and pitch, while others are plain. Some merely chirp with a merry heart. The robin opens up the choir in early spring, but his song is soon surpassed in beauty by the song sparrow and again by the rose-breasted grosbeak. The song of the wren trumps them all for longevity and vibrancy. The canary sings in a cage, while the nightingale sings in the dark. The robins sing in the rain. The buntings fill in the heat of the day when other birds are silent. As diverse as their song may be, they all commonly burst forth in exuberant happiness. It is here that they shall instruct us.

“Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord” (Eph 5:19). The advent of Christ was marked by the angelic host announcing peace and goodwill toward men. All those who will bear His name must deliver the same tidings. In John 4, we happen upon the scene at Jacob’s well, where Christ asks the woman for a drink. Her reply seems to bear a tinge of bitterness. “Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.” Though she esteemed herself as a spiritual person and willingly followed Him into religious discourse, she had no song. Like the well that they speak over, her water was buried deep below the surface and how laborious the effort to bring it forth. Christ offers another alternative. “But the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life” (John 4:14).

The well of Christ is an artesian well. One needs neither pitcher nor labor to draw it out, for it spews forth abundantly on its own accord. While Christ is probably speaking of the Spirit as in John 7:38, surely this may be just as applicable to a joy-laden heart. What is a more apt outpouring to flow from a Christ-inspired wellspring than the rapture of a song? “Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart” (Is 65:14). Now this should all seem plain enough to understand and easy enough to do but, alas, we find we have a constant and persistent adversary who seeks to thwart our song. We are not unaware of his devices...

Sin. Not all birds sing. There are some whose visage is black as sin. These only seem to screech and scream and are no example for the saints of God to emulate. The babbling noise we hear emanating from many passing vehicles certainly parallels the songs of such foul fowl. “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird” (Rev 18:2). These abundant creatures are the fallen spirits, the fowls waiting to devour the seed sown by the wayside. Of such are the worthless blackbirds, starlings, and grackles. The crows show themselves also at the roadside, feeding on rotting carcasses. Often you will find them in large numbers feeding themselves on the corn the farmer painstakingly planted for himself. So transgresses the selfish soul in his pursuit of happiness, feeding gleefully on the calamity of another and exploiting their sin. He bears no song, for his day is constantly clouded by the misdeeds of others who cross his path.

Neglect. The cowbird is also black (the female is brown/gray). She will be found sitting on a high vantage, shamelessly calling to her lovers by her shrill screeching. She then has the audacity to lay her egg in another bird’s nest, forcing them to raise her offspring. This is certainly a fitting emblem for a good number of females in our day. Though justified by circumstances, these women care not for their own, but are products of neglect. They have no lullaby to share with their young, for they have escorted them to the nest of another while her mind is preoccupied with work and business. “But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts” (Ps 22:9). No doubt that the singing mother can implant copious songs in her infant and set the stage for a happy and hope-filled life. While we may show mercy to a woman in dire circumstances, the major song of modern women bears chords that are but dissident and melancholy. These are stopped-up wells like unto the wells that Isaac found upon his return to Gerar. The Philistines “had filled them with earth” (Gen 26:15). So run the spiritually neglected homes of many families today, who pack their schedules so full of earthly commitments that they have no time to spend an hour in song together. If the birds stopped singing, would they even notice?

Ingratitude. Find a soul bathed in unthankfulness, and you will find a soul without a song. If the canary were to refuse to sing in captivity, few of us would ever have heard his rollicking melody. “We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof. For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion. How shall we sing the LORD’S song in a strange land?” (Ps 137:2-4). God’s people had been instructed by Jeremiah to build houses, plant gardens, and raise families. “… And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace” (Jer. 29:5-7). But they could see no worth in it. With their eyes fixed upon the dismal scene around them, they lost their song. Israel had within its history a rich tradition of song. Their singing erupted at the passage of the Red Sea in the days of Jehoshaphat and had been known to defeat armies. Earthly discomfort is no excuse to withhold gratitude, for our God reigns, and we are His children. Such were the conditions of the Philippian prison where two jailbirds, Paul and Silas, opened the concert at midnight and rocked the corridors with their joyful singing.

When we open our mouths and stretch our vocals in praise, we enact the grace of God. We join the faithful choir alongside Miriam, Deborah, and Hannah, and blend harmoniously with Moses, David, Paul, and Barnabas. At evening, we sing with our Lord and His disciples after supper, and with legions of angels “giving glory to God in the highest.” If that isn’t enough, perhaps we should consider rising at early dawn and singing with the innumerable hosts of our feathered friends who are thankful for God’s loving providence. “Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord … And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men” (Col 3:16, 23).

ہمارے باپ کی دنیا ایک ایسی دنیا ہے جو انسانی ایجاد و مداخلت سے نا آلودہ ہے۔ اگرچہ گناہ اور ٹیکنالوجی نے انسان ذات سے بہت سی خوبصورت چیزیں بگاڑ کر چھین لی ہیں، پھر بھی چند ایسی چیزیں باقی ہیں جو تہذیب سے اَنگاہ رہیں۔ ننھے بچے اپنی صاف و شفاف معصومیت میں صبح کے پاکیزہ روپ میں زمین پر ایک طرح کا جنتی منظر پیش کرتے ہیں اور دیکھنے والوں کو آسمان کی طرف متوجہ کرتے ہیں۔ ایک اور ہے آسمان کے پرندے جیسا کہ پیدائش میں مقرر ہے۔ پولس نے قورنثیہ جماعت سے التماس کیا، “Doth not nature itself teach you?” ہمیں کنولوں، غرابوں اور کھیت کی گھاس پر غور کرنے کی تلقین کی گئی ہے۔ ان میں سے ہر ایک اپنے وجود میں ابدی خدا کے ایک اہم پہلو کو ظاہر کرتا ہے اور ہمیں ان کے خالق کی تعریف سکھاتا ہے۔ شاید اگر ہمارے پاس وقت اور دیکھنے کی آنکھیں ہوں تو سارأ فطرت ہمیں جنتی مقامات کے جھلکیاں دکھا سکتا ہے۔

پرندے خدا کی مخلوق میں ایک منفرد مقام رکھتے ہیں، کیونکہ ان کا دائِرہ آسمانوں میں ہے۔ انسان ہوائی جہاز کے پروں پر سوار ہو کر چند گھنٹوں کے لیے زمین کے نچلے حصے سے اوپر جا سکتا ہے، مگر آسمان کبھی اس کی عام سلطنت کا مقام نہیں ہوگا۔ پرندے ایک آسمانی قوم کا عکس ہیں، کیونکہ وہ وہاں گھر جیسا محسوس کرتے ہیں۔ وہ خدا کے مقدّسوں اور فرشتوں کی قدرتی نمائندگی ہیں اور لہٰذا ہمیں انہیں مناسب توجہ دینی چاہیے۔ اگرچہ ان کشش اور حسین مخلوقات سے متعدد اسباق حاصل کیے جا سکتے ہیں، اُن میں سے ایک سب سے نمایاں اور شاندار خوبی ان کے بلند کردہ نغمے میں ملے گی۔ بہت سے زمینی جانور عملی طور پر خاموش ہیں۔ جو بولتے ہیں، وہ غالباً دھمکی دینے یا شکایت کا اظہار کرنے کے لیے بولتے ہیں۔ “Doth the wild ass bray when he hath grass? Or loweth the ox over his fodder?” (Job 6:5). جب وہ خوش اور مطمئن ہوتے ہیں تو ان کے پاس پہنچانے کو کوئی پیغام نہیں ہوتا۔ کتا داخل ہونے والے پر بھونکتا ہے تاکہ اسے بھگا دے، جبکہ بلی توجہ کے لیے میاؤں کرتی ہے۔ وہ تب بولتے ہیں جب خطرہ ہو یا عدم اطمینان، خوف یا درد میں ہوں۔ اسی طرح، زمینی انسان اپنے فطرت سے میدان کے ممالیہ جات کے ساتھ شریک ہے۔

پرندے متنوع ہیں۔ وہ اپنی خوشی بھری آوازیں اتنی بیشی کرتے ہیں کہ وہ خوشی کے مظہر بن جاتے ہیں۔ اظہارِ “خوش جیسے لکڑیا” اتنا عام محاورہ ہے کہ اسے وہ لوگ بھی استعمال کرتے ہیں جنہوں نے کبھی میدان میں جا کر لکڑیا کو دیکھا یا سنا ہی نہیں۔ اگرچہ بعض لوگ ہمیں بتائیں گے کہ یہ نغمے محض ملاپ کی پکاریں ہیں اور ان کا ان کے جذبات سے زیادہ تعلق نہیں، ہم اندرونی قناعت سے بچ نہیں سکتے کہ چاہے ملاپ ہو یا نہ ہو، یہ پرندے خوشی کی جوش بھری اظہار میں لذت محسوس کرتے ہیں اور ہمیں چاہئے کہ وہ ہمیں سکھائیں۔ “Is any merry? Let him sing psalms” (James 5:13). پرندے یہ مستقل کرتے ہیں اور کسی اور نتیجے تک پہنچنا مشکل معلوم ہوتا ہے مگر یہ کہ وہ یہ کرتے ہوئے خوش ہوتے ہیں۔ کسی لسبھ کے گھونسلے کے قریب گھومیں تو آپ پائیں گے کہ وہ ناقدانہ اظہار کے طریقے بھی رکھتے ہیں۔ کلڈیر بھی اپنے دائرے میں گھسنے والوں کے سامنے کھردرا ناپسند اظہار کرنے سے نہیں گھبراتا، مگر انہیں نغمے سمجھا نہیں جانا چاہیے۔ گانے والے پرندے خدا کے بندوں اور فرشتوں کا خوبصورت مصور کردہ منظر ہیں۔

ہماری سمجھ میں جنت کا کتنا کم علم ہے۔ مکاشفہ میں بیان کیے گئے آسمان کے مناظر ہمیں مشکل سے ہی ہماری محصور عقل کو اُس لافانی عالم میں لے جا سکتے ہیں۔ ایک جہت جس سے ہم رابطہ قائم کر سکتے ہیں وہ یہ ہے کہ یہ ایک ایسی جگہ ہے جو گلوکاری سے بھری ہوئی ہے۔ حیرت نہیں، کیونکہ یہ خدا کے شاد و مطمئن بندوں کا حتمی انجام ہے، اور وہاں وہ نئی سرود گائیں گے۔ تقریباً ہر منظر جو مکاشفہ کے تخت کے گرد دکھایا گیا ہے وہ کسی نہ کسی جہت میں حمد و ثنا کے نشان سے مزین ہے۔ “And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God” (Ps 40:3). تقریباً 22 مواقع پر صحیفہ جات اس فقرے کی تکرار کرتے ہیں: 'I will sing.'

پرندوں کی فطرت گانا ہے۔ صبح جب آسمان سنورتا ہے تو یہ ان کے جاگتے ہوئے خیال کا موضوع ہوتا ہے، اور یہ ان کے اندر سے چشمہ کی طرح بہہ نکلتا ہے۔ ان کے تمام نغمات ایک جیسے نہیں ہوتے۔ کچھ ڈھیروں طویل، بحر و مقام میں مخصوص اور ساز میں پیچیدہ ہوتے ہیں، جبکہ بعض سادہ ہوتے ہیں۔ کچھ محض خوش دل چہچہاتے ہیں۔ روبن بہار کے اوائل میں کوائر کھولتا ہے، مگر اس کا نغمہ جلد ہی 'song sparrow' (سنگ اسپراو) اور پھر 'rose-breasted grosbeak' (روز بریسٹیڈ گروس بیک) کے نغموں کے مقابلے میں کم خوبصورت معلوم ہوتا ہے۔ 'wren' (رین) کا نغمہ طول و شوخی میں سب پر بھاری ہے۔ کناری قفس میں گاتا ہے، جبکہ نائٹنگیل تاریکی میں گاتی ہے۔ روبنز بارش میں گاتے ہیں۔ بنٹنگس دن کی گرمی میں اس جگہ بھر دیتے ہیں جب دوسرے پرندے خاموش ہوتے ہیں۔ جتنی تنوع ان کے نغمے میں ہے، سب مشترکہ طور پر جوش بھرے خروش میں پھٹ پڑتے ہیں۔ یہی وہ جگہ ہے جہاں وہ ہمیں تعلیم دیں گے۔

“Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord” (Eph 5:19). مسیح کا ظہور فرشتوں کی فوج کے امن اور انسانوں کے لیے خیرسگالی کا اعلان کرنے سے نشان زد تھا۔ جو بھی اس کا نام رکھیں گے انہیں بھی وہی خوشخبری پہنچانی چاہئے۔ یوحنا باب 4 میں ہم یعقوب کے کنویں کے منظر پر پہنچتے ہیں، جہاں مسیح عورت سے پانی طلب کرتے ہیں۔ اس کا جواب تلخی کا رنگ لیے معلوم ہوتا ہے۔ “Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.” اگرچہ وہ خود کو روحانی شخص سمجھتی اور خوش دلی سے مذہبی گفتگو میں اس کے پیچھے چلتی، اس کے پاس کوئی نغمہ نہ تھا۔ جیسے جس کنویں کا وہ ذکر کرتی ہے، اس کا پانی اندر گہرا دبا ہوا تھا اور اسے نکالنا کتنا محنت طلب تھا۔ مسیح ایک دوسرا متبادل پیش کرتے ہیں۔ “But the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life” (John 4:14).

مسیح کا کنواں ایک آرتیزین کنواں ہے۔ اسے نکالنے کے لیے نہ گھڑا چاہیے اور نہ محنت، کیونکہ یہ خود بخود فراوانی سے پھوٹ پڑتا ہے۔ جبکہ مسیح بلاشبہ روح کے بارے میں بات کر رہے ہیں جیسا کہ یوحنا 7:38 میں ہے، یقینأ یہ خوشی سے لبریز دل پر بھی اتنا ہی قابل اطلاق ہو سکتا ہے۔ مسیح سے متاثر چشمہ سے بہنے والا کیا بہتر اظہار ہو سکتا ہے بہ نسبت ایک نغمے کے سرور کے؟ “Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart” (Is 65:14). یہ سب سمجھنے میں سادہ اور کرنے میں آسان معلوم ہونا چاہئے مگر افسوس، ہم پاتے ہیں کہ ہمارا ایک مسلسل اور مستقل دشمن ہے جو ہمارے نغمے کو روکنے کی کوشش کرتا ہے۔ ہم اس کے حربوں سے بے خبر نہیں ہیں...

گناہ۔ سب پرندے نہیں گاتے۔ کچھ ایسے ہیں جن کا چہرہ گناہ کی مانند سیاہ ہے۔ یہ محض چیخ و پکار کرتے ہیں اور خدا کے بندوں کے لیے تقلید کے قابل مثال نہیں۔ جو بکواس ہم بہت سی گزرتی گاڑیوں سے نکلتی ہوئی سنتے ہیں وہ بھی ایسے بدبو دار پرندوں کے نغموں کے مماثل ہے۔ “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils, and the hold of every foul spirit, and a cage of every unclean and hateful bird” (Rev 18:2). یہ کثرت سے پائے جانے والی مخلوقات زوال پذیر ارواح ہیں، وہ پرندے جو راستے کے کنارے بیج نگل جاتے ہیں۔ ایسے ہی ہیں بیکار کالے پرندے، اسٹارلنگز، اور گریکلز۔ کواڑ راستے کنارے بھی خود کو ظاہر کرتے ہیں، سڑے ہوئے لاشوں پر کھاتے ہیں۔ اکثر آپ انہیں بڑی تعداد میں فصل کے دانوں پر پاتے ہیں جو کسان نے محنت سے اپنے لیے بوئے ہوتے ہیں۔ اسی طرح خود غرض نفس خوشی کی تلاش میں دوسرے کی مصیبت پر خوشی مناتا ہے اور ان کا گناہ استحصال کرتا ہے۔ اس کے پاس کوئی نغمہ نہیں، کیونکہ اس کا دن دوسروں کی بری حرکتوں کی وجہ سے ہمیشہ بادل زدہ رہتا ہے۔

غفلت۔ گائے کا پرندہ بھی سیاہ ہوتا ہے (مادہ بھوری/سرمئی ہوتی ہے)۔ اسے اکثر کسی اعلیٰ مقام پر بیٹھا پایا جاتا ہے، بے شرمی سے اپنی تیز چیخ سے اپنے عاشقوں کو پکار رہا ہوتا ہے۔ پھر وہ ہمت کرتی ہے کہ اپنا انڈا دوسرے پرندے کے گھونسلے میں دے دے، اور انہیں مجبور کرے کہ وہ اس کے بچوں کو پالیں۔ یہ یقیناً ہمارے زمانے کی بہت سی خواتین کے لیے ایک مناسب استعارہ ہے۔ اگرچہ حالات کے بہانے جائز ٹھہرتے ہوں، یہ خواتین اپنی اپنی اولاد کا خیال نہیں رکھتیں، بلکہ غفلت کی پیداوار ہیں۔ ان کے پاس اپنے بچوں کو سنا دینے کے لیے لوری نہیں ہوتی، کیونکہ وہ انہیں اس کے گھونسلے تک پہنچا چکی ہوتی ہیں جبکہ ان کا ذہن کام اور کاروبار کی مصروفیتوں میں مصروف ہوتا ہے۔ “But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts” (Ps 22:9). بلا شبہ وہ ماں جو گاتی ہے اپنے بچّے میں کثیر نغمے بوتی ہے اور خوشی و امید سے بھرپور زندگی کے لیے بنیاد رکھتی ہے۔ اگر ہم کسی مشکل حالات میں خاتون پر رحم کریں تو بھی جدید خواتین کا بڑا نغمہ محض بیزار اور ملال انگیز دُھنیں لیے ہوتا ہے۔ یہ بند کنویں ہیں جیسے وہ کنویں جو اسحاق نے گیرار واپس آنے پر پائے۔ فلسطینیوں نے “انہیں مٹی سے بھر دیا تھا” (Gen 26:15). آج بہت سے خاندانوں کے روحانی طور پر نظر انداز گھروں کا حال کچھ ایسا ہی ہے، جو اپنی روز مرہ مصروفیات سے اِن اتنا بھردیتے ہیں کہ وہ ایک گھنٹہ بھی اکٹھے گانے میں صرف کرنے کے لیے وقت نہیں رکھتے۔ اگر پرندے گانا بند کردیں تو کیا وہ نوٹس بھی کریں گے؟

شکرگزاری کا فقدان۔ غیر شکرگزاری میں بھیگا ہوا نفس تلاش کرو، اور تم ایک ایسے نفس پاؤ گے جس کے پاس نغمہ نہیں۔ اگر کناری قید خانے میں گانا ترک کردے تو ہم میں سے بہت کم کبھی اس کے خوشنما نغمے سن پاتے۔ “We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof. For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion. How shall we sing the LORD’S song in a strange land?” (Ps 137:2-4). خدا کے بندوں کو یرمیاہ نے ہدایت دی تھی کہ وہ گھر بنائیں، باغ لگائیں، اور اولاد پالا کریں. “… And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captives, and pray unto the LORD for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace” (Jer. 29:5-7). مگر وہ اس میں کوئی قدر نہیں دیکھ سکے۔ اپنے آس پاس کے اداس منظر پر نظر جمائے، انہوں نے اپنا نغمہ کھو دیا۔ اسرائیل کی تاریخ میں نغمے کی ایک مالا مال روایت تھی۔ ان کا نغمہ سرخ سمندر کے عبور کے وقت پھوٹا تھا اور یہ فوجوں کو شکست دینے کے لیے بھی مشہور تھا۔ زمینی تکلیف شکرگزاری سے محروم رہنے کا عذر نہیں ہے، کیونکہ ہمارا خدا حکومت کرتا ہے، اور ہم اس کی اولاد ہیں۔ ایسے ہی حالات فلِپیان قید خانے کے تھے جہاں دو قیدی، پولس اور سلّس، آدھی رات کو کنسرٹ کھولے اور اپنے خوشگوار گیتوں سے راہداریوں کو جھنجھوڑ دیا۔

جب ہم اپنا منہ کھولتے ہیں اور حمد میں اپنی آوازیں پھیلاتے ہیں، ہم خدا کی رحمت کا مظاہرہ کرتے ہیں۔ ہم مریم، دیبورہ، اور ہنّہ کے ساتھ وفادار کوئیر میں شامل ہوتے ہیں، اور موسیٰ، داؤد، پولس، اور بارناباس کے ساتھ ہم آہنگی سے ملتے ہیں۔ شام کو ہم اپنے رب اور اس کے شاگردوں کے ساتھ کھانے کے بعد گاتے ہیں، اور ان فرشتوں کی لشکروں کے ساتھ جو “giving glory to God in the highest” ہیں۔ اگر یہ کافی نہ ہو تو شاید ہمیں صبح صادق اٹھ کر اپنے پر دار دوستوں کی لامحدود فوجوں کے ساتھ گانا چاہئے جو خدا کی محبت بھری تدبیر کے لیے شکریہ ادا کرتے ہیں۔ “Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord … And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men” (Col 3:16, 23).
